value.title: Il ritorno dei Guardiani della Galassia
value.synopsis: The Guardians of the Galaxy land on Earth to repair their ship at the same time Titus leads the Chitauri into targeting Nova's helmet. Now Spider-Man and Nova must work with the Guardians of the Galaxy to defeat Titus and the Chitauri. This episode was originally aired out of order to promote the Guardians of the Galaxy movie.

value.title: Spider-Man è un Avenger (1)
value.synopsis: After a case of mistaken identity, Spider-Man must convince his old team that he's the real Spider-Man before he is destroyed by his new team, the Avengers.

value.title: Spider-Man è un Avenger (2)
value.synopsis: Loki joins forces with Doctor Octopus to destroy the Avengers and their newest member, Spider-Man.

value.title: Un nuovo eroe
value.synopsis: While trying to become a crime fighter, Flash Thompson gets permanently bonded with Venom. It's up to Spider-Man to rescue his one-time school bully from the attentions of Venom, Beetle and Taskmaster. In the end, Nick Fury decides to give Spider-Man his list of teenaged superheroes.

value.title: Cloak e Dagger
value.synopsis: Spider-Man wants to recruit Cloak and Dagger as new warriors for his S.H.I.E.L.D. team. Complicating the matter, however, are Dormammu taking control of Cloak and Dr. Strange in an attempt to invade Earth, and Cloak and Dagger's own trust issues.

value.title: Il nuovo Iron Spider
value.synopsis: Science genius Amadeus Cho proves perfect to operate the Iron Spider armor. The only trouble is he's Peter Parker's class rival.

value.title: L'avvoltoio
value.synopsis: A mysterious thief known as The Vulture has been causing trouble. Spider-Man decides to track him down, and discovers he's a young man who has trouble remembering his past.

value.title: Spider-Man il selvaggio
value.synopsis: Spider-Man travels to the Savage Land with Wolverine to find Ka-Zar. Things become complicated as a result of a plan hatched by Taskmaster and Kraven the Hunter, who seek Ka-Zar and Zabu for their individual purposes.

value.title: Notte di Halloween al museo
value.synopsis: The cast of Jessie find themselves animated; Jessie finds a medieval sword coveted by Morgan Le Fay; the nanny teams up with Spider-Man to save Halloween and the world from Le Fay's evil plans. Note: This episode is a crossover with one of Disney Channel's live-action sitcoms - Jessie.

value.title: Nuovi guerrieri
value.synopsis: Spider-Man inspires new heroes to form the New Warriors, but their first challenge arises when Taskmaster and the Thunderbolts attack, forcing them to stop a breakout of Green Goblin, Dr. Octopus, Beetle, and Scorpion.

value.title: Incubo di Natale
value.synopsis: Spider-Man sees what the world would be like without him when Nightmare takes the web-slinger on a journey through his past, present, and future.

value.title: Lo Spider-universo (1)
value.synopsis: Goblin uses Electro to power up the siege perilous to collect the DNA of other Spider-Men. Spider-Man follows Goblin and boosts the confidence of Spider-Man 2099 and helps Spider-Girl to defeat Norma Osborn.

value.title: Lo Spider-universo (2)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man continues following Green Goblin across the multiverse to stop him from collecting Spider-Men DNA. He helps Spider-Man Noir to renew his friendship with Mary Jane and helps Peter Porker regain his will to become Spider-Ham.

value.title: Lo Spider-universo (3)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man helps Spider-Knight take down the medieval Dr. Octopus and save York, then helps Miles Morales forgive himself for what happened to Peter Parker in his universe.

value.title: Lo Spider-universo (4)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man faces the Spider-Goblin, created from Spider-Men DNA, and with the Web-Warriors' help, defeats him. Electro attempts to destroy New York but is stopped by Spider-Ham and Spider-Girl.

value.title: Accademia S.H.I.E.L.D
value.synopsis: Spider-Man's education at S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy begins but his academic career might be cut short when a villain is awoken from hibernation and sets his sights on destroying S.H.I.E.L.D.

value.title: La furia di Rhino
value.synopsis: Spider-Man and Hulk are the last line of defense when a bitter rivalry between Agent Venom and Rhino threatens to destroy New York City.

value.title: Ant-Man
value.synopsis: Spider-Man and Ant Man must shrink down into Fury's body that has been infected with Doc Ock's nano-bots.

value.title: Burritos, che passione
value.synopsis: Craving Mexican food, Spidey, Power Man and Squirrel Girl sneak out after hours for a burrito. Along the way they must contend with a plot from a group of Spider-Man's enemies.

value.title: Gli Inumani
value.synopsis: Spider-Man and Triton must stop a war between S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Inhumans.

value.title: L'attacco dei Sintezoidi
value.synopsis: Spidey wakes up to find his fellow classmates have been replaced by synthetic look-alikes. Not sure who he can trust, Spider-Man assembles a team to save the Academy.

value.title: La vendetta di Arnim Zola
value.synopsis: Spidey is captured by Arnim Zola. With time running out, his classmates must engage Zola in a desperate fight, giving Spidey the chance to rally and break free of the madman.

value.title: Sfida tra campioni (1)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man, the Avengers and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. battle their greatest foes for the fate of the planet. Spider-Man is chosen to be part of the Collector's team and is partnered with Hulk and Iron Man against the Grandmaster's team of villains consisting of Kraven the Hunter, Molten Man and Wendigo King.

value.title: Sfida tra campioni (2)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man is partnered with Captain America, Red Hulk and Iron Fist in a game of capture the flag against Sandman, Blastaar and Ymir. Then Spider-Man is partnered with Power Man, Black Widow and Skaar against Doctor Octopus, Absorbing Man and Zzzax in a game of last team standing but things become a problem when the Grandmaster starts changing the environment of the game.

value.title: Sfida tra campioni (3)
value.synopsis: Spider-Man teams up with Iron Spider, Agent Venom and Thor against Terrax, Attuma and Annihilus in a fight within the subway. Then Spider-Man uses Life Model Decoys to distract Grandmaster so he, Iron Spider and Agent Venom can board Grandmaster's ship to save the hostages. Can his plan succeed?

value.title: Sfida tra campioni (4)
value.synopsis: The Grandmaster has won the Contest of Champions, but Spider-Man asks for a winner take all rematch. Can Spider-Man win?
